captions.budget_and_mechanisms: Test-world means under the designed mixture. QA is an unseen rendering family on held-out worlds, not a within-world template intervention. Upper panels retain all four budgets, including the null primary result at 512 tokens. Lower panels show conditional post-minus-pre differences at the other prespecified primary budget, 2048 tokens; printed zeros are rounded descriptive estimates, not equivalence claims.
captions.support_and_source: Full-set membership is scored before the final budget stage. Pure sorting preserves membership, and source-policy filtering is disabled in this matched comparison. The joint G/U shares average paired variants within each world; designated-source retention and complete fact coverage are distinct endpoints.
captions.visibility_packing_policy: Fixed matched submatrices: packing and CE-view contrasts use post cap2, dense-view contrasts use no cap. Policy panel includes constrained tasks only; empty outputs count as noncompliant. The three filter placements have coincident aggregate coordinates at each budget. Points/bars are descriptive world means; no per-task independence or inferential interval is implied.
captions.answers_and_timing: Actual local answer-model outputs and online requests. Confidence bars come from exploratory seed-stratified paired-world analysis. Latency p50/p95 summarize measured requests; the interval panel first averages repetitions within each world. These are fictional administrative tasks, not clinical validation.
